Cox Purtell  
  Senior Salesforce System Administrator  
 You know Salesforce is only as strong as the way it is looked after. 
 Clean access. Sensible configuration. Stable releases. Good support. Strong governance. A platform people can actually rely on. 
 That is what this role is about. 
 You'll be joining a Brisbane-based university using Salesforce across existing and new platforms, including CRM, Marketing and Education Cloud. Some of the environment is established. Some of it is being improved and remediated. Your role will be to help look after the whole platform, not just one narrow part of it. 
 This will suit you if you are a hands-on Salesforce Administrator who likes ownership, cares about platform quality, and enjoys being close to the people who use the system. 
  The role  
 As the Senior Salesforce System Administrator, you'll help keep Salesforce stable, secure and useful across a large university environment. 
 You'll work across day-to-day administration, user support, configuration, platform improvement, release support and governance. 
 You'll be the person helping make sure Salesforce is well managed across CRM, marketing, engagement, alumni-style use cases and Education Cloud. 
 You'll work with the Salesforce Program Manager, architects, business analysts, DevOps specialists and business stakeholders. You won't be working in isolation, but you will be trusted to take real ownership of the admin layer of the platform. 
  What you'll be doing  
 You'll manage Salesforce users, roles, profiles, permission sets, licences and access controls. 
 You'll support Salesforce CRM, Marketing and Education Cloud usage across existing and new platform areas. 
 You'll provide practical support to users, helping resolve issues and improve how teams use Salesforce. 
 You'll configure Salesforce using declarative tools such as Flow, Approval Processes, Assignment Rules, Lightning pages, page layouts and permission structures. 
 You'll support sandbox management, release management and controlled deployment processes. 
 You'll help identify technical debt, platform risks, security issues and improvement opportunities. 
 You'll document changes, support adoption and create guidance that helps users get better value from Salesforce. 
 You'll help improve and remediate the platform while also keeping the current environment running properly. 
  What we're looking for  
 You'll bring strong hands-on Salesforce administration experience. 
 You might currently be a Salesforce Administrator, Senior Salesforce Administrator, Salesforce System Administrator, Salesforce Platform Administrator or Salesforce Consultant with strong admin capability. 
 Higher education experience would be useful, but it is not essential. 
 Experience in adjacent environments would be very relevant, particularly CRM, marketing, membership, alumni, engagement, customer service or stakeholder management platforms. 
 You'll be comfortable working in a complex Salesforce environment where different teams use the platform in different ways. 
 You'll understand Salesforce security, user access, profiles, permission sets, configuration, support and release processes. 
 Salesforce Administrator certification is preferred. If you are not certified yet but are actively working towards it, we are still happy to talk. 
  Why this role could be interesting  
 You'll have genuine ownership of a high-impact Salesforce platform. 
 You'll be involved in both improvement and remediation, not just routine ticket work. 
 You'll work across broad Salesforce use cases, including CRM, Marketing and Education Cloud. 
 You'll be part of a major university environment where Salesforce supports real engagement with students, staff, partners and alumni. 
 You'll have the chance to help create a strong higher-ed Salesforce case study. 
  Location  
 The university is based in Brisbane. 
 Brisbane-based candidates are very welcome and would spend regular time in the office. 
 We can also consider candidates in Sydney, Melbourne or other eastern Australian cities, provided you are willing to travel to Brisbane occasionally. As a guide, there will be an expectation to attend the Brisbane office at least once per month. 
  Work rights  
 We can only consider candidates with full work rights in Australia. 
 You will need to be an Australian citizen, Australian permanent resident or New Zealand citizen. 
  Key details  
 Role: Senior Salesforce System Administrator Platform: Salesforce CRM, Marketing and Education Cloud Contract: 12-month fixed term contract, likely to extend Package: $160,000 plus superannuation Location: Brisbane preferred; Sydney, Melbourne and other eastern Australian cities considered Work rights: Australian citizen, Australian permanent resident or New Zealand citizen only 
  Interested?  
 Apply with your CV or get in touch for a confidential conversation. 
 This is a strong role if you want to own, improve and support a Salesforce platform that matters.
